title: Is Emsculpt Neo Right for Me?
headings: Who Is A Good Candidate for Emsculpt Neo?
paragraphs: Emsculpt Neo is a non-invasive treatment that drives high-intensity electromagnetic energy through the skin to promote muscle growth and toning. Suitable for enhancing the abdominals, glutes, and thighs, Emsculpt Neo can boost your muscle mass and reduce your waistline.

Emsculpt Neo uses noninvasive HIFEM (High-Intensity Focused Electromagnetic) technology to induce vigorous muscle contractions that aren’t possible with exercise alone. One HIFEM treatment is the equivalent of a person doing 20,000 sit-ups in half an hour. As the muscles of the abdomen, glutes, or thighs are exposed to HIFEM, the tissue must adapt to extreme conditioning, resulting in muscle growth and sculpting.

Anyone who wants sculpted abs or glutes can see benefits with Emsculpt Neo. Patients who are near their target weight will be able to see the best results. Emsculpt Neo is perfect for patients with persistent fat pockets and doesn’t seem to want to budge despite a good diet and exercise.

To learn more about the benefits of Emsculpt Neo and whether this procedure is right for your goals, make an appointment or schedule a consultation at Marin Medical Aesthetics in San Anselmo. We offer a wide variety of treatments and help you find one or more options to help you achieve your goals.
Here are a few people that will be able to benefit from an Emsculpt Neo treatment:

Whether you’re getting back to working out after a break or transitioning into a new exercise program, changing up your fitness routine can make you more susceptible to injury. Emsculpt Neo helps strengthen core muscle groups, such as the abdomen, that are used to maintain stability through various exercises. Many patients use this to build strength up to where it is most needed.
Emsculpt Neo works well as an addition to physical therapy and is an excellent way for athletes and others to rebuild muscles after specific injuries.
People Who Want an Alternative to Plastic Surgery

People looking for a butt lift or who want to tone and tighten their muscles but don’t want to undergo surgery and be left with scars can turn to Emsculpt Neo as a good alternative. This non-invasive treatment doesn’t require anesthesia, and there is no lengthy recovery period like you would have to do if you were to get butt implants, tummy tuck, or liposuction.

As stated before, Emsculpt Neo treatments don’t require any pre-treatment preparations and no downtime afterward. Emsculpt Neo is an excellent choice for people looking to have a treatment done but don’t have time to disrupt their schedule or take time off work.

There have been studies that show Emsculpt Neo is an effective treatment for diastasis recti. Some reports have shown that it can help reduce gaps by up to 11% in the abdominal muscles affected by this condition. Diastasis recti is a condition that affects women who have given birth. However, it can be caused by a significant change in weight, certain surgeries, or by lifting heavy objects incorrectly. It can also affect both men and women. It is essential to mention that Emsculpt Neo is not advised for women during pregnancy.

Men and women who regularly work out or looking for a way to jumpstart a new fitness routine are great candidates for Emsculpt Neo. Patients must continue to exercise the muscle groups that Emsculpt Neo has targeted, and doing so will help you see the longest-lasting results. Emsculpt Neo is not a replacement for working out but rather a way to help boost your results from regular physical exercise and a healthy diet.
